items.title: A callback that return array of permissions

schema.title: JSON schema for Drupal permissions file

description:
Hello team,

Our latest permissions file defines two permission‐callback functions – **my_module_permission_callback** and **another_module_get_permissions** – which will supply additional permissions dynamically. In addition, we have three explicitly listed permissions. The first, **administer nodes**, is described as “Create, edit, and delete any content types on the site.” and is not restricted to trusted users. The second, **bypass node access**, “Grants the ability to view and edit nodes regardless of other access restrictions.” and is marked as restricted access, meaning only trusted users should receive it. Finally, **administer filters** allows “Configure text format filters and input processing settings.” and is also flagged as restricted access for security reasons.
